args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failed health checks

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, and v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy.

2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of just 0.2%.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the failed health checks on v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the recovery confirmation. The on-call engineer has been paged, and the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is flagged for investigation.
